_concepto: Segundo loop ambiente (11/9/2026). Un jardín japonés de noche bajo una lluvia fina: un estanque negro con koi naranjas y blancos, un farol de piedra con vela, farolitos rojos de papel, musgo, un arce. Doce encuadres del mismo jardín, cámara fija, un movimiento lento por plano. Lecciones de LLUVIA EN LA VENTANA aplicadas: negativos:false, primeros planos de objeto, nada abstracto, ninguna ventana con ciudad, ninguna silla vacía. El bucle se cierra en el corte K12 → K01.
_planta: El estanque en el centro; un deck de madera oscura en primer término (desde donde mira K01); al fondo a la IZQUIERDA el farol de piedra con su vela; a la DERECHA un arce de hojas rojas del que cuelgan dos farolitos rojos de papel; piedras con musgo en el borde; nenúfares a la derecha; un caño de bambú que gotea agua al estanque a la izquierda.
estilo_imagen: Hand-painted 2D animation background art for a calm night-time lo-fi music video: soft painterly brushwork, gentle film grain, a Japanese garden at night in fine rain. Deep blue-black water, warm orange and white koi, glowing red paper lanterns, the soft yellow flame of a stone lantern, wet green moss and dark red maple leaves. Muted but rich palette: ink black, vermilion, warm orange, moss green. Clean readable shapes, soft edges. Everything is still and quiet; fine rain draws small rings on the water. Nobody anywhere in the picture. The painting fills the ENTIRE 16:9 canvas from edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no cinemascope strip, no borders or frames of any kind.
medio: hand-painted 2D animated film with soft painterly textures, calm, slow and quiet

jardin.descripcion: a small Japanese garden at night in fine rain: a dark koi pond in the centre, a dark wooden deck in the foreground, a lit stone lantern at the back left, a red-leaved maple at the right with two glowing red paper lanterns hanging from it, mossy stones around the edge, lily pads at the right, a bamboo water spout dripping into the pond at the left

madre.prompt: Hand-painted 2D animation background art, wide 16:9 landscape frame, calm night-time lo-fi illustration style: soft painterly brushwork, gentle film grain. WIDE SHOT of a small Japanese garden at night in fine rain, seen from a dark wooden deck in the foreground. In the centre a still koi pond of deep blue-black water with small rain rings on its surface and four orange-and-white koi gliding just under the surface. At the back LEFT a stone lantern with a small warm candle flame glowing inside it, moss on its roof. At the RIGHT a maple tree with dark red leaves, and two glowing red paper lanterns hanging from its branches, reflected in the water. Mossy wet stones around the edge of the pond, a few lily pads at the right, a bamboo water spout dripping into the pond at the left. Beyond, only dark wet foliage and mist. Nobody in the garden. No text, no letters, no signs anywhere. This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no titles, no watermark. The painting fills the ENTIRE 16:9 canvas from edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no cinemascope strip, no borders or frames of any kind.

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE DEL BUCLE. El estanque entero desde el deck: farol, farolitos, koi bajo el agua, lluvia fina.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT of the whole garden from the wooden deck, the SAME view as the reference location picture: the dark koi pond in the centre with small rain rings and four orange-and-white koi gliding under the surface, the lit stone lantern at the back left, the maple with its two glowing red paper lanterns at the right and their reflections in the water, mossy stones, lily pads, the bamboo spout at the left. Fine rain, mist beyond. Nobody in the garden.
planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA on a tripod, perfectly still for the whole shot. Only slow ambient motion: the koi glide slowly under the surface, small rain rings appear and fade on the water, the lantern reflections wobble gently, the candle flame in the stone lantern breathes. The rain keeps falling for the whole shot and it stays night. Nothing else moves.
planos.audio: [Ambient] The only sounds are fine rain on still water, a soft steady drip from the bamboo spout, and distant night insects.

planos.funcion: La superficie del agua: anillos de lluvia y el reflejo rojo de un farolito.
planos.ve: One single picture filling the whole frame, seen from directly above: the still black water surface of a pond at night, filling the ENTIRE frame edge to edge, with many small concentric rain rings spreading and overlapping across it, and across the water the wobbling red reflection of a paper lantern and a thin warm reflection of a candle flame, both broken by the ripples. Only water, rain rings and reflected light: no fish, no plants, no shore.
planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA, perfectly still for the whole shot. Rain rings appear, spread and fade across the surface; the red reflection wobbles slowly with the ripples. The rain keeps falling for the whole shot. Nothing else moves.
planos.audio: [Ambient] The only sounds are fine rain on still water and distant night insects.

planos.funcion: Un koi solo, naranja y blanco, pasando justo bajo la superficie.

planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA, perfectly still for the whole shot. The koi glides slowly from one side of the frame toward the other with gentle sweeps of its tail and fins, staying just under the surface; rain rings appear and fade above it. The rain keeps falling for the whole shot. Nothing else moves.
planos.audio: [Ambient] The only sounds are fine rain on still water and a soft swirl of water from the fish.

Behind, out of focus, dark wet foliage and a soft red glow of a paper lantern. Only the stone lantern, the flame and the rain.
planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA, perfectly still for the whole shot. The candle flame breathes gently inside the lantern; drops of rain fall from the edge of the stone roof one after another; the moss glistens. The rain keeps falling for the whole shot. Nothing else moves.
planos.audio: [Ambient] The only sounds are fine rain on stone and leaves and a soft steady drip.

planos.funcion: Un farolito rojo de papel encendido, con gotas resbalando y hojas de arce.

planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA, perfectly still for the whole shot. The lantern sways very slightly; raindrops slide slowly down the paper; the leaves tremble as drops fall from their tips; the light inside breathes gently. The rain keeps falling for the whole shot. Nothing else moves.

planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA, perfectly still for the whole shot. The two koi glide slowly under the lily pads with gentle tail sweeps, one following the other; rain rings appear and fade; the lily pads rock very slightly. The rain keeps falling for the whole shot. Nothing else moves.

Fine rain. Nobody in the garden.
